idea-plugin.name: GitLab CI Companion
idea-plugin.description:
Static syntax and structural checks for .gitlab-ci.yml — catch mistakes before running a real pipeline, not after.

Flags jobs referencing a stage: not declared in the top-level stages: list, jobs missing script:/ trigger:/extends:, malformed rules: entries using an unrecognized key, jobs combining only:/ except: with rules: (GitLab silently ignores the former when the latter is present), and duplicate job names.

100% local, zero network calls — every check runs against the file already open in the editor, never a live GitLab API. Pipeline status and job log fetching are deliberately not built here (see this plugin's own README for why).

Free. No license nags, no telemetry, no popups.
